title: A Curious Eye
notes: A close-up eye drawn in pencil — long lashes curling above and below, with soft red shading and two bright highlights in the iris.

title: City of Nomyness
notes: A skyline full of colourful towers, a pink pyramid, smiley faces, stars and a little recycling sign — a whole little city dreamed up on paper.

title: Robot Buddy
notes: A friendly robot built piece by piece — hat, eyes, arms, body, legs and shoes.

title: The Curious Octopus
notes: Eight wiggly tentacles and two big shiny eyes, drawn in black marker.

title: Little Brown Friend
notes: A round chocolate-brown face with bright white eyes and a spiky hairdo.
